tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground (first stop of the body gradient). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: forest-green
tokens.usage: Primary backgrounds, navigation, critical CTAs. Used as text on `.brand-icon`, `.btn-primary`, `.stat-label`. 12.2:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: champagne-gold
tokens.usage: Accents, borders, geometric patterns, highlights.
